prompt: A net of a cube has how many squares?
hint: A net is the flat pattern you get when you unfold a solid. Each face of the solid becomes one piece of the net.

hints.text: A net is the flat pattern you get when you unfold a solid. Each face of the solid becomes one piece of the net.
Count the faces of a cube: one on top, one on the bottom, and the ones around the sides. The net needs a square for each.
A cube has $6$ faces, so a net of a cube has $6$ squares.

explanation: A net is a solid unfolded flat, so it has one flat piece for every face.
A cube has a top, a bottom and $4$ side faces, and every one of them is a square.
That is $1 + 1 + 4 = 6$ faces, so the net of a cube is made of $6$ squares.
